title: Exact Periodicity, Surjectivity, and a Haar Limit Law for a Restarting Josephus Process
summary: We study a restarting Josephus process in which the participants retain their linear order and counting restarts at the current leftmost survivor after every deletion. For step size $m$, put $q=m-1$, and let $F_n(q)$ denote the initial position of the survivor. Reverse insertion gives $F_1(q)=1$ and $F_k(q)=F_{k-1}(q)+\mathbf{1}_{\{q\bmod k<F_{k-1}(q)\}}$. Writing $L_n=\operatorname{lcm}(1,\ldots,n)$, we establish three results for the compatible residue system in this recurrence. First, the full period group of $F_n$ is exactly $L_n\mathbb{Z}$.
